daml-lf 2.1

package 9e1a0d3f... (Asset-1.0.0)

module Asset where

  record @serializable Asset = { issuer: Party, owner: Party, amount: (Numeric 10) };

  record @serializable Give = { newOwner: Party };

  record @serializable Peek = {  };

  variant @serializable Void = ;

  template (this: Asset) = {
    precondition True;
    signatories
      (\ (this: Asset) ->
         Cons @Party [Asset:Asset {issuer} this] (Nil @Party));
    observers
      (\ (this: Asset) ->
         Cons @Party [Asset:Asset {owner} this] (Nil @Party));
    agreement "";
    choice Consuming Archive (self) (arg: DA.Internal.Template:Archive):
        Unit
      , controllers
          (\ (this: Asset) (arg: DA.Internal.Template:Archive) ->
             Cons @Party [Asset:Asset {issuer} this] (Nil @Party))
      , observers (Nil @Party)
      to upure @Unit ();
    choice Consuming Give (self) (arg: Asset:Give):
        (ContractId Asset:Asset)
      , controllers
          (\ (this: Asset) (arg: Asset:Give) ->
             Cons @Party [Asset:Asset {owner} this] (Nil @Party))
      , observers (Nil @Party)
      to ubind
           (x: ContractId Asset:Asset) <-
             create @Asset:Asset
               (Asset:Asset { issuer = (Asset:Asset {issuer} this),
                              owner = (Asset:Give {newOwner} arg),
                              amount = (Asset:Asset {amount} this) })
         in upure @(ContractId Asset:Asset) x;
    choice NonConsuming Peek (self) (arg: Asset:Peek):
        (Numeric 10)
      , controllers
          (\ (this: Asset) (arg: Asset:Peek) ->
             Cons @Party [Asset:Asset {issuer} this] (Nil @Party))
      , observers (Nil @Party)
      to upure @(Numeric 10) (Asset:Asset {amount} this);
  };

module Transfer where

  record @serializable TransferProposal = { from: Party, to: Party, amount: (Numeric 10) };

  record @serializable Accept = {  };

  template (this: TransferProposal) = {
    precondition True;
    signatories
      (\ (this: TransferProposal) ->
         Cons @Party [Transfer:TransferProposal {from} this] (Nil @Party));
    observers
      (\ (this: TransferProposal) ->
         Cons @Party [Transfer:TransferProposal {to} this] (Nil @Party));
    agreement "";
    choice Consuming Accept (self) (arg: Transfer:Accept):
        (ContractId Asset:Asset)
      , controllers
          (\ (this: TransferProposal) (arg: Transfer:Accept) ->
             Cons @Party [Transfer:TransferProposal {to} this] (Nil @Party))
      , observers (Nil @Party)
      to create @Asset:Asset
           (Asset:Asset { issuer = (Transfer:TransferProposal {from} this),
                          owner = (Transfer:TransferProposal {to} this),
                          amount = (Transfer:TransferProposal {amount} this) });
  };
